lines.text: Jerusalem's father was an Amorite and her mother a Hittite, and she was thrown into the open field at birth.
God covered her with His cloak, made a covenant with her, and put a bronze helmet on her head.
Trusting in her beauty, Jerusalem used God's gold and silver jewelry to make idols and sacrificed her children to them.
Jerusalem prostituted herself with the Egyptians, then the Assyrians, then Chaldea, and was still not satisfied.
God will gather her lovers against her, and a mob will stone her and cut her with axes.
